COSMIX ALGORİTMA

EKIMIMIZ
HAKKINDA Algoritma Akademi'den tutkulu ve yaratıcı bir ekipiz; bilim, teknoloji, yenilik ve uzay keşfiyle ilgileniyoruz.

ABOUT OUR PROJECT
SPACE MISSION SIMULATOR is an interactive educational game that lets players create their own space missions by choosing rockets, spacecraft, scientific tools, and mission goals.

OUR GOAL
To make space exploration fun, interactive, and educational.
